content: The architectural parameters and hyperparameters listed in Table TABREF6 were selected through an exhaustive grid-search based on the validation set of PHASE-ONE. We conducted a series of empirical studies starting from single hidden-layered networks for each of the blocks and, based on the validation accuracy, we increased the depth of each given network and selected the optimal parametric set from all possible combinations of parameters. For the gradient boosting classification, we fixed the maximum depth at 10, number of estimators at 5000, learning rate at 0.1, regularization coefficient at 0.3, subsample ratio at 0.8, and column-sample/iteration at 0.4. We did not find any notable change of accuracy while varying other hyperparameters while training gradient boost classifier.
